notes: Three «ح» branches meet at «كلهم عن هشام، بهذا الإسناد»; the tail is written once after the last branch (rule 3), so it belongs to all three groups.
«كما قال أبو أسامة» and the «وفي حديث» lines are wording remarks, not a second isnad; left out.
«وسلوا زيد بن ثابت» is a remark of the report, not a link.
